summary: Wrote a twelve-phase implementation plan for the T-arrival substrate redesign. Phase 1 lands the untl-side incompleteness before the redesign removes the ability to state it; phase 2 lands LiftableRaw and its two sufficiency lemmas free-standing; phase 3 adds the trans and lift skeleton fields with every producer as one atomic batch; phases 4-5 insulate Formula- and Plus-side thread-step consumers behind thread_share_succ; phase 6 flips Thread.step to trans and reproves total_eq_thread from lift; phases 7-8 re-quantify (C1') over trans on each side, with phase 8 retiring the five now-unprovable incompleteness theorems and their C2 and theorem-index rows in the same edit; phases 9-10 land Families A and B as in-tree certificates with the positive theorems replacing them; phase 11 preserves the closure-necessity obstruction as a wired evidence probe; phase 12 does docs, the additive export contract, and the full gate set. Every phase ends green; the two atomic-batch phases are pre-declared.

artifacts.summary: Twelve-phase T-arrival substrate refactor plan, 21.5 hours estimated across 10 dependency waves.

user_decision.question: Task 694 prescribes the trans datum this plan implements as a strict subset (no arrival pruning, no closure field, no untl-side result, no gate families). Both research rounds recommend folding it in. How should task 694 be disposed of?
options: Abandon task 694 as superseded by task 696's plan
Re-scope task 694 to the deferred exact-closure work (LiftWindow, liftable_of_liftWindow, Decidable LiftWindow), which this plan lists as a non-goal
Leave task 694 as it stands and accept the duplicated work
user_decision.recommended: Re-scope task 694 to the deferred exact-closure work (LiftWindow, liftable_of_liftWindow, Decidable LiftWindow), which this plan lists as a non-goal

next_action_hint: Run /implement 696 to execute the plan, starting with wave 1 (phases 1 and 2, both independent).
